identity.name: Burnt Ends Restaurant
identity.note: Official contact page distinguishes restaurant #01-02 from Burnt Ends Cocktail Bar #01-04 at the same street address. Bakery, Cellars, Meatsmith and other group brands are not this restaurant. Search-discovered burntendsrestaurant.com at River Valley Road is not used.

sources.observation: Operator contact page provides the restaurant-specific #01-02 address, restaurant hours and general enquiry email. Cocktail bar #01-04 is separately identified.
The Burnt Ends restaurant section has Reserve link https://burntends.com.sg/reservation/ which redirects to https://burntends.com.sg/reservations/. Other group venues have distinct entries.

Parent CUA inspected the official reservation page DOM and expanded its original iframe. Exact iframe source is https://www.restaurants.sg/modules/booking/book_form_section.php?bkrestaurant=SG_SG_R_BurntEnds&bktracking=WEBSITE&title=Burnt%20Ends . Provider form identifies Burnt Ends Restaurant and is powered by Weeloy. Static web extraction only showed the separate seating-gallery preview; the parent browser establishes the actual form.

Exact original iframe URL from the official restaurant booking page, observed by parent. Initial form has restaurant identity, restaurant seating options separately from cocktail-bar options, two guests, lunch/dinner choice and October 2026 calendar. Date remains unselected; no real time slots or reservation confirmation observed.
